leadText: This is a list of opening themes that have been played in the dub of the Pokémon animated series.
plainText:
This is a list of opening themes that have been played in the dub of the Pokémon animated series.

==Main series==
 

==Movies==
 

==Specials==
 

===Summer Holiday Fan Club===
 
Summer Holiday Fan Club was used as the opening theme of Pikachu's Summer Vacation in home video release and during TV broadcasts on SBS.
 
! Korean
! English

츄츄 피카피카 츄츄 피카피카 
색색 비치볼을 안고서 바닷가를 달리자
츄츄 피카피카 츄츄 피카피카 
옆집 철이 손잡고 크게 크게 웃어보자 (하하하)
츄츄 피카피카 츄츄 피카피카
 
태양이 제일 제일 불타는 계절

지난 해 여름방학이 끝난 그 순간부터
계속 기다려왔어 올해의 여름방학을

꽃무늬를 입고 춤을 춰
여름방학 팬클럽 (예!)
불꽃놀이가 예쁘네
여름방학 팬클럽
여~름~방~학
 

Chu-chu pika pika chu-chu pika pika
Let's run along the seaside holding colourful beach balls
Chu-chu pika pika chu-chu pika pika
Let's laugh out loud holding hands with Cheol from next door (hahaha)
Chu-chu pika pika chu-chu pika pika

The season when the sun burns the strongest

From the very moment last summer vacation ended
I've been waiting for this year's summer vacation

Dance wearing a floral pattern
Summer vacation fan club (yeah!)
The fireworks are beautiful
Summer vacation fan club
Sum~mer~ vaca~tion 

 

==Trivia==
The 2015 Korean redubbing of Guardian Gods of the City of Water: Latias and Latios used an original instrumental piece with additional dialogue during the opening instead of having an opening theme. This piece was directed by Kim Jeonga, and composed and arranged by Yu Taejin and Kim Jeonga.
